answer: Rule: each epoch issues only 40 identity slots by sealed-bid auction, each costing the clearing bid of 25 units locked until audit. An attacker wanting 10 fakes must outbid honest operators in a meadow of real demand, so the price per fake climbs with each slot won and total cost rises faster than the count. No fable of free identities: a low bid cannot forge one, and a proven fake forfeits its lock.
